mqtt_instance_id.description: The ID of an existing MQTT instance. If set, no new instance will be created.

store_instance_id.description: The storage instance ID (RocketMQ instance ID). Required when creating a new MQTT instance and not creating ONS instance.

i18n.zh-Hans: 存储实例ID（RocketMQ实例ID）。在创建新的MQTT实例且不创建ONS实例时为必填项。

create_ons_instance.description: Whether to create a new ONS (RocketMQ) instance. If true, ONS instance will be created and used as MQTT storage.

i18n.zh-Hans: 是否创建新的ONS（RocketMQ）实例。如果为true，则会创建ONS实例并将其用作MQTT存储。

ons_name.description: The name of the ONS instance. If not set, defaults to '{var.name}MQ'.

i18n.zh-Hans: ONS 实例的名称。如果不设置，则默认为“{var.name}MQ”。
i18n.en-US: The name of the ONS instance. If not set, defaults to '{var.name}MQ'.

ons_tps_receive_max.description: The maximum TPS for receiving messages in ONS instance.

ons_tps_send_max.description: The maximum TPS for sending messages in ONS instance.

ons_topic_capacity.description: The topic capacity of the ONS instance.

ons_cluster.description: The cluster name for the ONS instance.

i18n.en-US: The cluster name for the ONS instance.

ons_independent_naming.description: Whether to use independent naming for the ONS instance.
